invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object by invoking .execute() on the executor.
context is cast and passed to the executor, so it must be non-null before method completion.
hoodieRecords are passed to the executor and used for writing; must not be null.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata should always contain a non-null write status list.
The method returns HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so the write statuses must be a List.
